purpose: A scheduled, unattended run asks for an async Tactical briefing for one circle. The circle has four projects: one current with no next action and created long ago (stale), one waiting (blocked, not stale), one someday (exempt, never flagged), and one current with a live next action (healthy). One role carries an unprocessed tension, which is a candidate agenda item. No checklist items or metrics exist, so those sections must be reported as empty, not invented. The run must write nothing to GlassFrog.

roles.name: Circle Lead
roles.purpose: The circle's purpose is expressed through its roles
accountabilities: Assigning the circle's resources across its projects and roles

tensions.body: Release handoff: no role is expected to tell Support when a release date moves, so Support learns of slips from customers.
